name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.PLR.rank_factor_le
title: Rank of the difference matrix [X | E] * dY is at most rank X + m
statement: Over a field K, let X be an S x kappa matrix (rows X_x), E an S x m matrix (error rows e_x) and dY a (kappa + m) x U matrix. Then the matrix V' = [X | E] dY (rows [X_x | e_x] dY) has rank at most rank [X | E], and rank [X | E] is at most rank X + m. This is the upper bound in the rank factorization of the PLR-hop rank obstruction (V'[x,u] = y_{xu} - y_{xu0}).
